description: The system datasets an Assette tenant must provide for the platform to operate. Each dataset is a named data block executed via the Data Preparation Service (mcp__assette__execute_data_block). validate_system_data.py checks executed responses against this spec; the names here are the canonical spec names - a tenant may name blocks differently, in which case the /validate-system-data command records search_blocks candidates instead of auto-substituting.

datasets.name: Source_ListofAttributeTypeValues
datasets.purpose: Master list of classification attributes such as strategy, vehicle, and client type, with their codes and display values.
datasets.why_needed: Assette classifies every account and product by these attributes. Without them, account/product filtering, product pages, generation-tray dropdowns, and permissioning cannot resolve.

constraints.description: The attributetype column must include at least: Strategy, Vehicle, VehicleCategory, AssetClass.
VehicleCategory attribute values must be one of: Pooled, Segregated.

datasets.name: Source_CountryList
datasets.purpose: Master list of countries related to where you offer products and create outputs.
datasets.why_needed: Country reference data drives product-offering scopes, country dropdowns, and localized outputs.

datasets.name: Source_ExtractAccountsDetails
datasets.purpose: Details about your accounts: the unique account code, name, category, key dates, base currency, and owning product.
datasets.why_needed: Accounts are the primary axis of report generation - account pickers, permissions, performance and holdings outputs all resolve from this dataset.

constraints.description: portfoliocategory must be one of: Individual Account, Consolidated, Group, Composite.

datasets.name: Source_AccountAttributesValues
datasets.purpose: Maps each account to the attributes in the attributes master list.
datasets.why_needed: Account-to-attribute mappings power strategy/vehicle/asset-class filtering, account grouping, and content limitations. Every account must carry the core attributes for the platform to route it correctly.

constraints.description: Every account must be mapped to at least: Strategy, Vehicle, VehicleCategory, AssetClass.

datasets.name: Source_ProductMasterExtract
datasets.purpose: Details about your products: codes, names, strategy, vehicle, asset/share class, and the performance / representative accounts.
datasets.why_needed: Products are the second primary axis of report generation - product pickers, product profiles, and composite links all resolve from this dataset.

datasets.name: Source_ProductOfferCountries
datasets.purpose: Which countries each product is marketed in.
datasets.why_needed: Drives where-offered filtering and country-specific compliance on product materials.

datasets.name: Source_ListOfCurrencyCodes
datasets.purpose: Master list of currencies related to where you offer products and create outputs.
datasets.why_needed: Currency reference data drives currency dropdowns, base-currency display, and multi-currency outputs.

datasets.name: Source_IndexDetails
datasets.why_needed: Benchmark identity is required for any versus-benchmark performance, attribution, or characteristics output.

datasets.name: Source_IndexAccountAssociation
datasets.why_needed: Tells the platform which benchmark(s) to show against each account - without it, benchmark columns and relative metrics cannot be produced.

datasets.name: Source_GetGroupAccountCode
datasets.purpose: Group accounts and their member accounts.
datasets.why_needed: Needed when you report on group accounts - the platform expands a group into its members for consolidated outputs.

datasets.name: Source_SubAccountsRelationship
datasets.note: Optional, but required for permission aspects.
datasets.purpose: The groups each account belongs to.
datasets.why_needed: Needed for account-level permissioning - the platform resolves a user's permitted accounts through these group memberships.
